reason: The plugin is primarily a terminal-enabled mode for the web GUI: it registers a third 'Code' segment, replaces the conversation column with a harness terminal session, and links that session to workspace/session metadata so users can resume and create new terminal conversations. It also provides reconnect behavior and directory/workspace-aware session handling, indicating a user-facing terminal orchestration tool rather than code-generation or data-processing logic.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面新增“Code”模式，切换后在对话主区显示对应会话的终端界面，并按工作区/会话上下文对终端会话进行关联与恢复。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a Code mode to the DeepSeek Harness web UI that opens a terminal session in the conversation area and links it to workspace/session context so terminal sessions can be resumed and managed.

capabilities: Launches and manages terminal processes from the web host context
Exposes a terminal WebSocket stream endpoint for browser-terminal relay
Resumes and attaches terminal sessions to workspaces/conversations by session id
Can execute a configurable launcher command/profile in user-selected directories

reasons.code: README: adds a Code segment beside Chat/Work and uses a terminal column in the conversation UI, including websocket-backed terminal integration at /omdsh-codemode/terminal.
README: starts the terminal app with session identity (`--session-id`) and resumes/reattaches sessions across page/conversation changes.
package.json: runtime dependencies include node-pty and ws, and peers/include web client/runtime services needed to run terminal and websocket behavior.
